In detail

East of the river, past the walls. San Michele Extra and Porta Vescovo both appear in the Prefettura's zone rosse, which were extended here after episodes of vandalism, brawls, dealing and theft — 206 removal orders were issued across all of Verona's red zones in the first eight months of 2026. Porta Vescovo is also the one L'Arena reported on as recovering, so the direction of travel is not all one way. Residential, few reasons to be here at night.
